title: Cartoon meadow
notes: Tiles are 64x64 and snap to a 64 px grid. Terrain comes in three themes: terrain_grass_*, terrain_snow_*, terrain_sand_*. Each theme has solid ground pieces (…_block_top_left, …_block_top, …_block_top_right on the surface row; …_block_left, …_block_center, …_block_right below; …_block_bottom_* for the underside; …_block for a single tile) and thin floating platforms (…_cloud_left, …_cloud_middle, …_cloud_right, or …_cloud alone). Player (green) and player2 (pink) are 96x96 facing right: *_idle, *_walk_a, *_walk_b, *_jump, *_duck, *_hit, *_climb_a, *_climb_b, *_front (flip X to face left). Enemies are 64x64 facing left with frames: slime_normal_(rest|walk_a|walk_b|flat), slime_spike_*, bee_(a|b|rest), snail_(walk_a|walk_b|rest|shell), mouse_(walk_a|walk_b|rest), frog_(idle|jump|rest), saw_(a|b|rest) spins as a hazard, fish_blue_(swim_a|swim_b|rest). Pickups: coin_gold/_silver/_bronze (+ _side for spin), gem_blue/green/red/yellow, key_* with lock_*, heart, star. Goal: flag_green_a/flag_green_b wave, flag_off before reached. Hazards: spikes, lava/lava_top, water/water_top, saw. Props: spring/spring_out, ladder_top/middle/bottom, bridge, block_coin(_active), block_exclamation(_active), block_empty, block_planks, bush, cactus, fence, mushroom_*, rock, sign*, door_*_(top), grass, hill*, torch_on_a/b. HUD: hud_heart, hud_heart_half, hud_heart_empty, hud_coin, hud_character_0..9, hud_character_multiply, hud_player_green, hud_key_*. Backgrounds are 256x256 tileable: background_color_hills/_trees/_desert/_mushrooms (layered scenery), background_clouds, background_solid_sky. Sounds: jump, jump_high, coin, gem, hurt, bump, disappear, magic, select, throw.
